ai.error: OPENAI_API_KEY or LLM_MODEL is not configured

body_excerpt:
The SMB client uses a dedicated key type to request negotiated authentication credentials from a userspace helper, and the key description carries authority bearing fields such as process id, user id, credential user id, and the upcall target. The helper treats those fields as trustworthy because it assumes they were produced by the kernel. However, an ordinary userspace process can create keys of the same type directly through the key request and key add system calls, so it can populate those fields itself without the request ever originating from the file system client.

Products not listed in the Impact Details section have not been evaluated.  Furthermore, products that have exceeded any software maintenance time periods are also not evaluated and will not be published.  Please consult End of Sale and End of Service Life - Extreme Networks for the EOL notices related to the product under question.
